method.canonicalization: Because the argument is a string, JSON.stringify emits a JSON string literal (surrounding double quotes + escaped \n). The hash is over that quoted/escaped form, NOT the raw joined UTF-8 text and NOT the array of pairs.

notes: Raw sha256(joined-string)=1fba71c1... and sha256(array-of-pairs)=7886ad8b... are the two non-matching variants that produced the earlier misdiagnosis; superseded by docs/issue-93/CENTRAL_SNAPSHOT_HASH_ERRATUM.md. Private fact pool, source refs, UUIDs and queries are not published.
